selection_rule: Broad equally spaced nominal H overview; nearest existing H, ties within 1e-12 resolved towards larger H. No occupancy/contrast maximum used in selection.
interpolation: Piecewise-linear Delaunay in unit-normalised log10 coordinates, intersect convex hull with adopted exact stepwise inner domain
scope: Descriptive Results-C maps at four fixed habitat proportions; full joint256-profile response, no parameter binning or marginal averaging, no new simulations or CIs
